analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: read each source, extract the as-designed statements as CHECKABLE rules into normative_models, mirroring what was done for POST2BUDGET
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: BBP-04, 06, 07, 10 and the UMOJA peer baseline ingested into normative_models.B2R: 17 rules with the delta measured on each. PSM_FM, CO, PS and PBC S_STANDARD_REF NONE -> PARTIAL; PSM_FM G_CONFORMANCE also PARTIAL. The synthesis is the deliverable: three unbuilt foundations and eleven consequences, not fourteen gaps.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Fill S_STANDARD_REF for the B2R domains from the 7 ranked sources in brain_v2/s_standard_ref_sources.json. This is the HIGHEST-VALUE unblock in the model: S is empty in 20 of 21 domains and G_CONFORMANCE is empty BECAUSE of it — no standard reference means no delta, and the delta IS the product. KEEP THE TWO KINDS APART. Only the Umoja and OECD peer material is genuinely SAP-STANDARD; the BBPs are UNESCO's AS-DESIGNED intent authored by consultants. Recording as-designed as 'standard' would make every UNESCO choice look like SAP behaviour and every SAP deviation look like a defect — two different yardsticks, two different findings. START WITH PSM_FM (BBP-04: BCS 7 dimensions, the AVC address triple, PBET) because it is our best-covered domain and the triple names something our own avc_availability_model.md currently has no word for.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: quantify the reconciliation cost from the reporting programs; then ask the business
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: The 2017 design's HARD PREREQUISITE — consolidating nine FM areas into one (UNSC) — was never implemented, and production still runs nine. Establish what that costs today and whether it is still intended: consolidated reporting needs manual reconciliation across nine areas, a unified commitment-item catalog is impossible, and a single derivation strategy cannot exist. Check too whether the nine-area structure is what makes the FMDERIVE design unimplementable, since one strategy across nine areas was its premise. This is a governance question, not a technical one: after nine years either the consolidation is abandoned and the design should be retired, or it is pending and nothing is tracking it.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: trace how a C/5 programme report is actually produced today
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: FUNCTIONAL AREA is blank in all 2,308,814 FM line items. BBP-04 defines it as UNESCO's C/5 EXPECTED RESULTS — the dimension used for statutory reporting BY PROGRAMME OBJECTIVE. So either programme-objective reporting is produced from somewhere other than FM, or it cannot be produced from the financial system at all. Find out which. If it comes from elsewhere, find the source and record it, because it means the money-to-purpose link lives outside the ERP. Start from the ytfm_fund_c5 / ytfm_c5 tables, which map fund to C/5 output by biennium and are already in the golden — that may BE the workaround.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: this is the dimension that ties money to mandate in an organisation whose mandate is expressed as C/5 Expected Results

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: grep the callers of check_conditions_2 in extracted_sap_p01/YA for iv_hkont
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: IV_HKONT is OPTIONAL and guarded by IS NOT INITIAL, so the empty-range trap fires only if a caller passes it. And CHECK_CONDITIONS_2 has NO CALLER in the extracted corpus. The bigger question is whether the STAFF gate is called at all — unanswerable until the ENHOs are read.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.status: QUALIFIED s097 — blocked on the enhancements
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: MR_HKONT is declared at line 57 of YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL and NEVER POPULATED, yet CHECK_CONDITIONS_2 — the STAFF gate — checks IV_HKONT IN MR_HKONT at line 366. In ABAP a value IN an empty range is FALSE, so whenever a GL account is passed that gate fails ALWAYS. Same shape as the known mr_waers defect, found the same way.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: join FMFINCODE type against FMFUNDTYPE ZZFIX_RATE, restricted to types 001-099
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: The budget-rate solution scopes funds two different ways and nothing reconciles them. EXECUTION converts only the 14 types flagged ZZFIX_RATE in FMFUNDTYPE. REPORTING (YFM_CONSTANT_DOLLAR and its two variants) defaults to the literal range 001-099. Quantify the gap: how many funds have a type inside 001-099 WITHOUT the ZZFIX_RATE flag, and how much volume sits on them. Those funds appear in the constant-dollar report having never been converted — which is exactly how a report and an engine come to disagree.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the reporting perimeter is operator-changeable, so the mismatch moves

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: identify deferred-revenue accounts in SKA1/SKB1, then trace clearing in bseg_union
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: BBP-06 designs revenue as DEFERRED at invoice (donor agreement signed) and RECOGNISED at cash receipt. That is an IPSAS revenue-recognition policy. GM does not exist, so the designed mechanism cannot be running — find out whether an equivalent deferral runs in FI instead, or whether the accounting answer is not being produced at all. Start from the deferred-revenue GL accounts and their clearing pattern against donor receipts.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: a revenue-recognition policy that no mechanism implements is an audit finding, not a backlog item

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: root(POSID) not in funds.FINCODE, joined against proj ERDAT and ERNAM
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: 191 WBS roots do not exist as funds and 325 WBS elements fail to resolve at all. Classify them — the convention is load-bearing, so its exceptions are where it breaks.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: depth(POSID)>4 in prps, crossed with proj and the INT-01 payload shape

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the address chain is held together by convention, so its exceptions are exactly where it fails silently

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the address chain is held together by convention, so its exceptions are exactly where it fails silently

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: attribute_changes_to_programs.py using fund-master activity as the change stream

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the address chain is held together by convention, so its exceptions are exactly where it fails silently

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: join fmioi amounts per reservation document across periods; CDPOS value history is deferred by standing decision, so use the period-over-period amounts
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Reservations are carried to the end of a budget period and adjusted a median of 6 times. The open question is the DIRECTION of those adjustments: an amount that falls in step with consumption is a commitment drawdown and is unremarkable; an amount that is restored is a HOLD, and no report names that practice. Measure the direction per document.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: 6.4M change documents rest on this distinction, and the two readings have opposite audit consequences

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: walk SETNODE parent-child, resolve leaves through SETLEAF, join to fmifiit_full FISTL
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: class 0312 traversed: 15 roots = C/5 biennium x FM area, depth 3, 454 of 717 fund centres reached. 258 orphans (36.0%) carrying 474,874 FM lines (20.6%). No within-tree double counting; 272 values versioned across bienniums.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: the fund-centre hierarchy is now held (class 0102: 1,459 sets, 1,406 nodes, 3,175 leaves, nested 1,737 parents over 4,320 children). Traverse it and attach every FM posting to its roll-up path, then answer the question the model has never been able to answer: what does each organisational level actually consume, and does the hierarchy agree with the 3-letter acronym grammar the fund centres use.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: Fund Centre is the only live organisational dimension in the FM ledger, and until now it had no structure to roll up through

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: classify the 258 by FM area and by first posting date; then find which reports aggregate on class 0312 and check what they show for those codes
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: Not a decayed master: 240 of 263 orphans never post. Three fund centres are 98.1% of the orphan volume — UNESCO the root catch-all (14.36% of the ledger, structural), CSI Coastal Regions and Small Islands (3.89%, the real gap) and MBF Medical Benefits Fund (1.93%, plausibly by design). Flat across 2024-2026, so nothing is winding down. And no custom programme we hold reads class 0312 — the two that read sets both read 0102, GL account groups.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: 258 fund centres (36.0%) belong to no hierarchy and carry 474,874 FM lines — 20.6% of the ledger — so every organisational roll-up under-reports by that much silently. They are numeric codes while the hierarchy is built on three-letter acronyms. Establish whether they are a legacy population being wound down, an institute convention outside UNES, or a maintenance gap — and whether any report currently presents an organisational total that omits them.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: a total that omits a fifth of the ledger without saying so is the shape of a finding, not a data-quality note

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: read the C/5 nodes of the 41/42 trees for a sector that should contain CSI; cross its funds and its posting pattern against a comparable attached centre
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: Not a programme that was never attached. The acronym CSI was REUSED: the fund centre is 2002 'Coastal Regions Small Islands', its money since 2021 is the Special Account for Capital and Strategic Investments (fund 643CSI9000, type 313), and the fund-centre text was never updated. It is a revenue collector — 99% payroll-driven postings to commitment item REVENUE, avg 79.67 — which a programmatic hierarchy of spending activities has no node for. And the deeper reason nothing is attached: the hierarchy is FROZEN — 25 set changes in the whole window, none on fund centres.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: CSI (Coastal Regions and Small Islands) posts 89,846 FM lines, 3.89% of the ledger, and belongs to no node of the fund-centre hierarchy. Unlike the UNESCO root and the Medical Benefits Fund, there is no structural reason for it to be outside. Establish whether it is a programme that was never attached, one deliberately reported another way, or a remnant of a discontinued sector — and what any organisational total for its sector currently shows.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: it is the one orphan of size whose absence from the structure has no explanation yet

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: look for standard FM reporting (FMEQ/FMRP_*) and BI extraction on FISTL in the execution log via A8, rather than assuming the custom corpus is the whole story
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: No organisational roll-up exists. FMHICTR (fund-centre hierarchy) is EMPTY while FMHICI (commitment item) and FMHIVARNT carry data. The standard FM reporting layer is heavily used (RFFMEPGAX 441 users) but aggregates on what is spent, not on who spends it. So the orphan fund centres distort nothing — the dimension is simply not reported on.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Three measurements say the organisational roll-up is configured but inert: the fund-centre hierarchy has had zero maintenance in the observable window, no custom programme we hold reads its set class, and 20.6% of FM lines post outside it. Before proposing any repair, establish what actually produces organisational totals today — a standard FM report, a BI extract, a spreadsheet — because repairing an unread structure changes nothing.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: it decides whether the hierarchy is a defect to fix or a remnant to retire, and those have opposite costs

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: for each custom field that duplicates a standard one, compare population and then grep which is read by the executed programs from the audit log
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Three times now a dimension exists in two places at once and nothing declares which is authoritative: fund scope for the budget rate (ZZFIX_RATE versus the literal 001-099 range), the organisational hierarchy (set class 0312 versus the empty FMHICTR), and the fund-to-C/5 link (native FMFINCODE.ZZOUTPUT versus the bridge ytfm_fund_c5, disagreeing on 5,626 funds). Sweep for the rest of the pattern rather than finding them one at a time, and for each pair establish which one the running reports actually read.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: a future design that picks the wrong carrier inherits a silent disagreement, and this installation has at least three of them

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: select fmifiit_full on the perimeter, derive the implied rate per line from the transaction and local amounts, and compare with TCURR for the posting date
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the perimeter is measured and the record table covers it at 99.8% in 2025. What is still not measured is the AMOUNT effect — ZFKBTR against what the standard rate would have given.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Measure what the budget rate actually did, INSIDE the standard tables, since there is no shadow to diff. For FM lines that fall inside the eight-dimension perimeter — ledger 9A, company UNES, FM area UNES, business area GEF, currency EUR, commitment item excluding GAINS and REVENUE, transaction excluding HRM1/HRM2/HRP1, fund type among the 14 flagged ZZFIX_RATE — compare the rate implied by the posted amounts against the standard rate for the same date. The difference is the mechanism's effect.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: every statement we hold about the budget rate is still about design. This is the only route left to its effect, now that the shadow-ledger route is known not to exist

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: check the creation date of YTFM_BR_FMIFIIT in TADIR and its transport, then compare 2024 posted rates inside the perimeter against TCURR for the same dates
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the mechanism DID run in 2024, on 7.6% of the perimeter (740 of 9,737 lines), reaching 94.7% in 2025. The control table's emptiness in 2024 said nothing about it.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: The budget rate was activated from 20240101 by TVARVC and the 2024 perimeter holds 10,660 FM lines, yet YTFM_BR_FMIFIIT has ZERO rows for 2024 and its earliest processing stamp is 2025-01-13. Anyone reconciling 2024 needs the answer and the two cases have opposite consequences.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: a year of the mechanism is either unrecorded or did not happen

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: test DMBE2 against the fixed rate for the same documents the control table names; the 12,396 matched FM lines give an exact document list to join on
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: the FM ledger, via exchange rate type EURX at 1.09529. 94.7% of the 2025 perimeter against 0.09% outside it. FI/GL stays on the standard rate by design, and the FM-minus-FI difference is the reported impact.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: The fixed rate is known: 1.0416667. What is not known is which field the enhancements write it to. Eliminated by measurement: the FKBTR-to-TRBTR relationship in fmifiit_full (it appears less often inside the perimeter than outside) and the EUR budget in bpja (all at rate 1.0). Remaining candidates worth testing in order: the FI document — BSEG second local currency DMBE2, which the BI extractor already reads for USD — then the commitment lines in fmioi, then the reporting layer alone, which would mean the mechanism never touches a posting at all.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the whole budget-rate question reduces to this. Everything else about the mechanism — perimeter, gates, defects — is known

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: join fmifiit_full perimeter lines at EURX to bseg_union on (BUKRS, KNBELNR, KNGJAHR, KNBUZEI) and difference FKBTR against DMBTR

Both sides are now identifiable: FM lines carrying EURX inside the perimeter, and their FI counterparts through KNBELNR/KNGJAHR/KNBUZEI plus BUKRS. Compute the difference in money, by year and by fund, and reconcile it against what the constant-dollar reports state. That number is what the organisation calls the budget-rate impact.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: everything about the mechanism is now known except the one number it exists to produce

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: grep the call sites of CHECK_CONDITIONS and CONVERT_TO_CURRENCY across package YA and the enhancements, and read the actual argument list at each

The staff path gates on PERNR through a different class.

Enumerate the call sites — the 12 ZFIX enhancements plus the five other BR classes — and record, per call site, which of the eight parameters it supplies. That table IS the real perimeter, and it is the only way to know which postings the mechanism can reach.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: the difference between 'the class defines a perimeter' and 'each caller defines its own' is the difference between a rule and a convention

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: compare document types and entry transactions for the 2024 pairs against the 2025 ones
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: EURX is the UN operational rate FROZEN at the start of the biennium — the operational rate itself was 1.09529 from 2024-01-15 and again from 2024-08-15. So the 2024 lines matching EURX are rate coincidence, not conversion, and their impact is exactly 0.00.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: In 2024 the 740 perimeter lines at EURX pair to FI lines carrying the SAME 1.09529 rate, so FM and FI agree and the impact is exactly zero — unlike 2025 and 2026 where FI runs on a moving rate. Establish why: documents entered with EURX on both legs, a year-end revaluation, or the mechanism working differently in its first partial year.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.why_it_matters: a year where the impact is structurally zero is either correct or a gap

Then split the population by WRTTP to see how much sits outside route 1.

Read the payroll schema and its rules to find where the fixed rate is applied to staff cost, and establish whether its perimeter matches the non-personnel one or differs.

The PAYROLL POSTING path ran six runs in JANUARY 2025 and stopped — 703 employees, 633 of them inside the YYCDR perimeter. The PBC POSITION path never wrote, because its calls are behind IF 1 = 2. Establish whether it was switched off deliberately, failed and was abandoned, or was a pilot that never went further. The payroll schema is the place to look — the FM side only records what arrives.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: walk T52C1 from YR00 following COPY and PIT steps, resolving rules in T52C5

That is the A_PROCESS cell for payroll and it is currently PARTIAL on an inventory alone.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction._origin: user: combining the execution logs with PBC and the FI document headers is powerful

Verified by arithmetic: a PPDIT line of 46.80 is 10.96 + 35.84 of PPOIX. The run-level reading of that chain is what exposed the simulations.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Combine three streams that are each already held: the EXECUTION LOG (who ran what and when, 15.6M audit rows), the PBC output (FMRESERV change documents, 6.4M headers, and the HRM1/HRM2 commitment lines in FMIOI), and the FI DOCUMENT HEADERS (bkpf, now 122 columns including WWERT and KURSF). Joining them gives the chain from a payroll RUN to the documents it produced, with the person or channel that triggered it — which none of the three answers alone.

analysis_tasks_no_extraction.method: group cdhdr_history by OBJECTCLAS and TCODE, flag users whose route differs from the modal route for that object
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.result: built as ALGORITHM A17. Two kinds emitted: SOLE_USER_OF_A_GENERIC_ROUTE and GENERIC_ROUTE_IS_THE_NORM — the second is the stronger and the first version missed it. NRINTERVAL is the case: SE38 is the modal route among 18 maintainers.
analysis_tasks_no_extraction.task: Generalise the finding into a detector. For every change-document object, compare the TRANSACTION CODES its maintainers use. hypotheses_from_operator_memory.connects_to: A10 found fmioi carries FONDS/FISTL/FIPEX at 100% and no MEASURE, so the reservation sits on the same two-legged address as everything else
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.data_on_hand: cdhdr 6.4M FMRESERV headers + fmioi 2,190,893 commitment lines — enough
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.hypothesis: FUND RESERVATIONS ARE USED AS A ROLLING HOLD. The organisation reserves funds and then ADJUSTS the reservation MONTH BY MONTH specifically so the funds are never released. If true, the earmarked-funds mechanism is not a commitment instrument here — it is a budget-retention instrument, which is a different thing with different audit consequences.
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.method: measure the change CADENCE per reservation document, not the volume. For each OBJECTID in cdhdr/cdhdr_history where OBJECTCLAS='FMRESERV': count distinct months with a change, the gap distribution between changes, and the lifetime. A rolling hold shows as many documents with a change in almost every month of their life and few final closures. Then cross to fmioi to see whether the AMOUNT moves down in step with consumption (a genuine commitment drawdown) or is topped back up (a hold).
hypotheses_from_operator_memory.result: RETENTION confirmed, MONTHLY refuted. Documents living >=6 months are touched in 32% of their months (median 6 changes), and lifetimes spike at 13 and 25 months — the biennium. So reservations are carried to the end of a budget period rather than consumed and closed. The naive all-documents ratio of 0.96 was an artifact of single-month lives.

A create-once commitment does not generate that volume. CONTINUOUS ADJUSTMENT does.

YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL has THREE gates, and CHECK_CONDITIONS_2 is explicitly the STAFF gate: it accepts EUR *and* USD (the main gate accepts EUR only) and it INCLUDES HRM1/HRM2/HRP1 — the PBC pre-commitment, PBC commitment and payroll transactions the main gate excludes. s4_readiness_submodel._design: S/4HANA Migration Readiness — the COMPOSITE sub-scorecard that R_S4_READINESS rolls up from (fractal: the operating model one level down). Factors below are VERIFIED by research wh5gw9exu (s079, 22/25 claims 3-vote confirmed). s4_readiness_submodel._scoring_rule_critical: CVI_MIGRATION_PRECHK 'All applied Checks (0/0)' means NO check ran (zero records selected), NOT a clean pass. Any automated scorer MUST distinguish 0/0 (no denominator) from 0-errors-of-N. Source: SAP KBA 3478108 (VERIFIED 3-0).

claims.claim: AVC available is a fund/cover-group level metric, not an FR-line-level metric. All FR lines on the same (FONDS, FUNDSCTR, CMMTITEM-rolled-to-control-object) draw from a single shared AVC pool. The pool is calculated as: Available = FMAVCT.allotment - sum(open FMIOI commitments) - sum(FMIFIIT actuals) on the same key. FMAVC005 fires when Available <= 0 + new posting amount > 0. The triggering FR line is incidental; the constraint is the fund pool.

claims.claim: BCM routing at UNESCO is triggered by tcode OBPM5 configuration (table TFIBLMPAYBLOCK, 2 rows): LAUFK=' '/P + LAUFI='*' + XBATCH='X' — wildcard routes EVERY F110 and Payroll run into BCM evaluation. Downstream filters reduce actual BCM batch creation: (1) PM must be DMEE-enabled (T042Z.XBKKT='X' — 100% clean cut: no XBKKT='' ever creates a BCM batch), (2) co code ICTP is structurally excluded (0/603 runs), (3) BCM grouping rules (IMG > FSCM > BCM > Payment Grouping > Rule Maintenance) evaluate and assign one of 14 UNESCO-custom RULE_IDs (UNES_AP_ST, UNES_TR_TR, PAYROLL, IIEP_AP_ST, UIS_AP_MAX, UBO_AP_MAX, UIL_AP_ST, UNES_AP_10/11/EX/IK, UNES_AR_BP, UBO_AP_ST, UIS_AP_ST). The observation 'LAUFI ending in B ↔ BCM batch' (100% correlation) is a SYMPTOM of UNESCO naming convention for BCM-destined F110 variants combined with the OBPM5 wildcard match, NOT a SAP routing rule. Supersedes legacy brain memory claim 'LAUFI prefix B=BCM, 0/T/M=Direct' (falsified: prefix-B runs have 0% BCM linkage; prefix-0 runs with suffix-B have 100%).

evidence_for.cite: BNK_BATCH_HEADER: 27,443 batches 2014-2026, 100% have LAUFI ending in B. REGUH (full schema extract 15mo, 505,636 rows, 9,163 distinct runs): XBKKT='' → 0/2,941 BCM (100% clean negative), XBKKT='X' → 1,045/6,222 BCM (16.8%). Co code ICTP: 0/603 BCM. Companies UNES/IIEP/UIL/UBO/UIS: 10-29% BCM within XBKKT='X'.

Full config (2 rows only): {MANDT=350, LAUFK=' ', LAUFI='*', XBATCH='X'} and {MANDT=350, LAUFK='P', LAUFI='*', XBATCH='X'}. Stored in Zagentexecution/sap_data_extraction/extracted_data/payment_process_full/TFIBLMPAYBLOCK_full.json

https://sapinsider.org/sap-bank-communication-management-what-you-need-to-know/ — confirms OBPM5 identifier matching with BRM checkbox is the routing mechanism. 'Entering an asterisk in the field under the Identifier column and selecting the check box under the BRM column tells the system to send all payment runs to SAP Bank Communication Management.'

https://www.se80.co.uk/saptables/t/tfib/tfiblmpayblockid.htm — confirms TFIBLMPAYBLOCKID is 'Run Identification for Cross-Payment Run Payment Medium'. Tcode OBPM5 = 'Cross-Payment Run Payment Medium / Reservation for Cross-Payment Run Payment Media'.

Tested REGUV.X_WF_ACTIVE across 16,142 REGUH runs (28 months): FLAG IS NEVER SET (0 rows with 'X'). UNESCO does not use the SAP-standard workflow activation flag. BCM routing happens via OBPM5 wildcard config, not via REGUV per-run flag.

claims.claim: XSLT CGI_XML_CT_XSLT (SAP-std, devclass=ID-DMEE) is an identity transformation with EMPTY-ELEMENT REMOVAL. Template 1 matches '*[not(child::node())]' with empty body — deletes any leaf element with no children/text. Template 2 matches '*[string() or @*[string()]]' — copies elements with text content or attributes with values. EFFECT: V001 structured PstlAdr nodes that are empty (e.g., <BldgNb/> when vendor has no HOUSE_NUM1) are AUTOMATICALLY REMOVED from final XML before file write. claims.claim: INC-000008088 Treasury interest GL split is constrained by an architectural invariant: bank statements can only be re-routed to specific GLs when the bank emits a SPECIFIC external transaction code (e.g. NINT — Normal Interest) that distinguishes interest from other credits. claims.claim: ADT REST source PUT (/sap/bc/adt/programs/programs/{name}/source/main) is BROKEN on NW 7.40 EhP8 for PROGs in $TMP — returns HTTP 423 'Resource INCLUDE not locked (invalid lock handle)' regardless of lock URL (program shell vs source/main) or lockHandle position (X-adtcore-locktoken header vs lockHandle query param). The lock returned by ?_action=LOCK&accessMode=MODIFY has IS_LOCAL=X (correct for $TMP) but the PUT's lock-check rejects it. Empirically reproduced 3 times 2026-05-25 with fresh CSRF + fresh lock per attempt. Diagnosis: kernel-version limitation on EhP8 ADT, not a wrapper bug — POST to create the PROG and POST to lock both succeed; only the PUT to source/main with the otherwise-valid handle fails. WORKING ALTERNATIVE: use RFC RPY_PROGRAM_INSERT with SOURCE_EXTENDED (TABLE OF ABAPTXT255) + SUPPRESS_DIALOG='X' + DEVELOPMENT_CLASS='$TMP' — RFC-enabled (TFDIR FMODE=R), accepts wide source, auto-activates. For PROGs in transportable Z packages the ADT path may behave differently — not yet tested. Secondary finding: sap_adt_client.py create_object has a generic XML namespace bug for PROG/P — builds xmlns:program=http://www.sap.com/adt/programs (short, derived from path domain segment) but SAP expects http://www.sap.com/adt/programs/programs (full path). Fix: type-specific namespace_uri override in _CREATABLE_TYPES.

evidence_for.cite: HTTP 423 + body <type id=ExceptionResourceInvalidLockHandle/><message>Resource INCLUDE ZABAPGIT_STANDALONE is not locked (invalid lock handle: 1A08CF3C91866665684BC44C5D9A46F46C816F4C)</message>. Reproduced with lock at shell URL AND lock at source/main URL — both gave a lock handle, both rejected at PUT.

RPY_PROGRAM_INSERT (signature: PROGRAM_NAME, TITLE_STRING, SUPPRESS_DIALOG, DEVELOPMENT_CLASS, SOURCE_EXTENDED as TABLE OF ABAPTXT255) — call returned OK in 32.3s, 151,660 lines uploaded and auto-activated.

domain_root = meta['path'].split('/')[0] — for PROG/P path='programs/programs', so domain_root='programs', producing xmlns:program=http://www.sap.com/adt/programs (short). Reference: marcellourbani/abap-adt-api/src/api/objectcreator.ts CreatableTypes[PROG/P].nameSpace='xmlns:program="http://www.sap.com/adt/programs/programs"' (full path).

claims.resolution_notes: WORKAROUND in production via RPY_PROGRAM_INSERT for PROG source upload to $TMP. ADT REST path documented as broken — wrapper should add a kernel guard or fallback. Pending: (a) fix create_object PROG/P namespace bug; (b) test ADT REST source PUT for PROGs in TRANSPORTABLE Z packages (may behave differently); (c) document in sap_adt_api SKILL §15 alongside the existing DDIC EhP8 limitation note. SECONDARY LESSON 2026-05-25 (Session #76): when an ADT REST create_object call creates a PROG skeleton (r3state='I' shell), a subsequent RPY_PROGRAM_INSERT with full source creates the ACTIVE version but DOES NOT clean up the orphaned 6-line INACTIVE shell. SE38 Display then shows the misleading inactive shell as if the install were empty. Verified empirically — `READ REPORT name INTO tab STATE 'I'` returned 6 lines while STATE 'A' returned 151,660. Fix: after any RFC-based PROG creation that follows an ADT REST attempt, run `DELETE REPORT name STATE 'I'.` via RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN. Cleanup script archived at Zagentexecution/abapgit_install/drop_inactive_shell.py. F8/Activate from the stale SE38 view of the inactive shell would replace the active 151,660 lines with the 6-line empty header — DESTROYING the install. Always clean orphan inactives.

It uses NO ODP Data Replication API (RODPS_REPL_*, ODQ_* Operational Delta Queue, /SAPDS/ operators, CDS/extractor/DataSource subscriptions). Therefore it is OUT OF SCOPE of SAP Note 3255746 ('Unpermitted usage of ODP Data Replication APIs', updated 2026-04-13) and is unaffected by the 2026-06-09 Patch-Day patch that blocks unauthorized ODP-RFC calls. A Gold DB refresh runs unchanged after the patch.

evidence_for.cite: rfc_read_paginated() -> _rfc_read_single_page() issues conn.call('RFC_READ_TABLE', QUERY_TABLE=table, DELIMITER='|', ROWCOUNT=batch_size, ROWSKIPS=offset, OPTIONS=rfc_options, FIELDS=rfc_fields). This is the sole shared extraction primitive imported by every extract_*.py.
Extraction thread calls RFC_READ_TABLE with ROWCOUNT/ROWSKIPS pagination and a WHERE clause pushed via OPTIONS. Standard generic table read, no ODP context.

Repo-wide grep for ODP replication APIs (RODPS_REPL, ODQ_, /SAPDS/, RODPS, ODP_) across all .py files = 0 calls. Only token match is a name-classifier regex in sap_brain.py:863 (r'ODQ_|RSN3|RSCOLL' labels BW/Analytics objects in the knowledge graph) -- a classifier, not an ODP call.

claims.claim: UNESCO's entire Gold DB extraction floor (24M+ rows, ~68 extracted tables) depends on a SINGLE function module -- RFC_READ_TABLE. As of 2026 this is SAP-tolerated and is the vendor-recommended compliant alternative to ODP-RFC (Theobald), so it is NOT restricted by Note 3255746. Residual risk is strategic/directional, not imminent: SAP is broadly moving to gatekeep third-party data access (Forrester 2026) and steer customers to SAP Business Data Cloud / ODP-OData. IF SAP ever extends restrictions to generic table-read RFC, the entire Gold DB refresh is the single point of failure. Mitigation: ODP-OData / Business Data Cloud (CDS/OData building blocks exist via sap_segw). Monitor; not urgent.

evidence_for.cite: Single point of dependency: every extract_*.py routes through the shared rfc_read_paginated() -> RFC_READ_TABLE. There is no second extraction mechanism feeding the Gold DB.

Note 3255746 formalizes SAP policy of blocking third-party direct data access (ODP first). RFC_READ_TABLE is the more exposed flank under the same governance philosophy and is documented by SAP as not released for productive use. Forward-looking inference, not a current restriction.

claims.resolution_notes: Reframed Session #78 after web corroboration: earlier wording (RFC_READ_TABLE not released / the exposed flank) was an overstatement. Current consensus = table-read RFC is the recommended compliant path. Risk downgraded to strategic-direction watch item.

claims.claim: The currency of a revaluation/bank GL account is read from the account master TEXT (SKAT) + the document currency, NOT from SKB1.WAERS. SKB1.WAERS is the account-currency control, often blank/local; the operative currency (e.g. Citibank Dakar 1143254 = XOF) is identifiable from the SKAT account name and the FX document currency. Gold DB P01_SKA1/SKAT extracts carry these texts.

evidence_for.cite: 1143254 SKB1.WAERS blank but SKAT name = Citibank Dakar (XOF); FS10N shows XOF balance. Confirms currency source = SKAT name + doc currency.

claims.claim: WBS PS-budget channel is GUI-only (CJ30/KBPP family) — no clean single-call RFC equivalent. KBPP_EXTERN_UPDATE raises DA300 NOT_FOUND without the full CJ30 buffer/profile context even with IMP_CHECK=X. Custom Y*BUDGET* FMs are readers/loggers only; BAPI_BUS2054_SET_STATUS = status only; BAPI_0050_CREATE = FM fund-center object (OBJNR FS*), NOT WBS (OBJNR PR*). WBS budgeting is a TWO-STEP process: (1) CJ30 sets the original/current budget → stored in BPJA as WRTTP=41 (current budget); (2) CJ32 releases it → stored in BPJA as WRTTP=42 (released budget). Budget is ANNUAL (table BPJA by GJAHR), NOT overall (BPGE WRTTP=01 was empty for WBS 650RER0008 / OBJNR PR00021132). Corrects the earlier '0 budget in P01' which only checked BPGE/overall — BPJA WRTTP=41 (GJAHR=2026) had the 10,000 USD entry. BPGE WRTTP=01 = overall-level; BPJA WRTTP=41 = annual current; BPJA WRTTP=42 = annual released; VERSN=000 throughout. Budget-exceeded message = BP/604 (PS-AVC engine, not FM-AVC). RESOLVED s-2026-07-01 (was open — see KU-2026-CJ32-RELEASE-NOT-LANDING, now closed): PS-AVC/BP-604 checks the RELEASED budget WRTTP=42 (set by CJ32), NOT the original/current WRTTP=41 (set by CJ30). Proof: WBS 650RER0008 (OBJNR PR00021132) has WRTTP=41=10,000 USD for FY2026 but WRTTP=42=0, and BP/604 still fires on a posting attempt — the WRTTP=41 entry alone does not satisfy AVC. Therefore CJ32 release is MANDATORY, not just CJ30; the two-step CJ30→CJ32 sequence is a hard AVC precondition, not merely bookkeeping.

evidence_for.cite: Verified live RFC D01/P01 2026-06-30: KBPP_EXTERN_UPDATE raises DA300 NOT_FOUND without CJ30 buffer context; BAPI_0050_CREATE addresses OBJNR FS* (fund center), never PR* (WBS); BAPI_BUS2054_SET_STATUS = status-only; custom Y*BUDGET* FMs are readers. BPGE PR* WRTTP=01 VERSN=000 confirmed as the WBS budget storage row.

BPJA WRTTP=41 GJAHR=2026 VERSN=000 = 10,000 USD (entered via CJ30). WRTTP=42 GJAHR=2026 = 0 after two CJ32 release attempts (release not landing — see KU-2026-CJ32-RELEASE-NOT-LANDING). BPGE rows for same OBJNR = 0 (budget is ANNUAL, not overall). Corrects earlier 0-budget diagnosis which only checked BPGE/overall.

With BPJA WRTTP=41=10,000 USD (FY2026) present and WRTTP=42=0 (unreleased), a posting attempt still raised BP/604 (budget exceeded, PS-AVC). Empirically confirms PS-AVC evaluates WRTTP=42 (released), not WRTTP=41 (current) — resolves KU-2026-CJ32-RELEASE-NOT-LANDING's core question and confirms CJ32 release is mandatory.

claims.claim: Cost-recovery WBS carry 0 PS-budget in BPGE on BOTH P01 and D01 (verified: 650RER0008 = 0 BPGE rows WHERE OBJNR LIKE PR*). Spendability of CR WBS comes from the FUND-level budget (633CRP9003, OBJNR FS*, claim #268/#287), NOT from a WBS-level PS-budget entry. Therefore a BP/604 (PS-AVC budget-exceeded) on a CR WBS in D01 signals a PS-AVC profile CONFIG DIFFERENCE (D01 has PS-AVC active; P01 relies on FM-AVC fund-level coverage for CR objects), not genuinely missing budget. Test-unblock path: CJ30 give the WBS a nominal PS budget in D01. Structural fix: align the PS-AVC/budget-profile between D01 and P01 for CR project types. Refined s-2026-07-01: this is one of TWO DISTINCT budget layers per fund/project that must not be conflated — (a) FUND disponible = FM/BCS AVC ledger 9H (FMAVCT), loaded via ENTR/B1/BAPI_0050; (b) WBS PS budget = classic PS budgeting (BPJA WRTTP=41/42 at OBJNR PR*, CJ30/CJ32 GUI, no clean RFC). A cost-recovery test posting needs BOTH layers satisfied; they are separate AVC systems and one being funded does not satisfy the other.

claims.claim: Structured-address scope clarification (resolves the project's core question, TIER_1): AdrLine (free-text address line) satisfies payment DELIVERY (the payment clears) but is NOT 'structured address' in the ISO 20022 / SWIFT CBPR+ / EPC sense (machine-parseable, separately tagged StrtNm/BldgNb/PstCd/TwnNm/CtrySubDvsn/Ctry). claims.claim: FMAVCT (AVC totals ledger 9H) rows on V01 exceed RFC_READ_TABLE's 512-byte line buffer -- the same field-split + row-index-merge technique used elsewhere in this landscape (rfc_helpers.rfc_read_paginated) is required: split the field list into <=8-field chunks, issue one ROWSKIPS-free (ROWCOUNT=0) call per chunk per year, then merge rows by index position. A per-year row-count-equality guard across chunks is mandatory (a mismatch means the index-merge is unsafe and the year must be skipped, not merged blindly). WHERE-clause equality options need spaces around '=' ("RYEAR = '2026'"); "RYEAR='2026'" (no spaces) raises OPTION_NOT_VALID/DB_Error on this wrapper. RRCTY discriminates budget (1, ~7.2k rows in 2024) vs consumption (0, ~6.9k rows in 2024); RCVRGRP_9 is uniformly blank on V01; RVERS='000', RLDNR='9H'. V01 2026 FMAVCT is nearly empty (44 rows) -- expected, since 2026 budget/consumption is mid-year and low relative to prior years (14,086 rows 2024 / 2,577 rows 2025).
evidence_for: Zagentexecution/sap_data_extraction/scripts/extract_v01_funds_wbs.py -- FMAVCT_CHUNKS (5 chunks of <=8 fields) + read_fmavct_year() (per-chunk ROWSKIPS-free read, row-count-equality guard, index merge).

claims.claim: THE PBC ENCUMBRANCE RULES, READ FROM PRODUCTION — the AS-DESIGNED half of the largest write path in the installation (s097). DO_HANDLE_VACANCY drops any position whose HROBJECT_DP is populated (occupied) and clears the position pointer on the person — so an occupied post commits nothing of its own and the commitment comes from the PERSON. That is what prevents post and holder being counted twice. The code carries its own statement of intent: 'UNESCO requires Precommitment ONLY for vacant and integrated positions'. CAVEAT: the comment says the pointer deletion is 'deactivated' while the code does it — comment and code disagree, code is authoritative. R2 COMMITMENTS PRO-RATE BY DATE INTERSECTION. Three cases in ADJUST_REQ_WITH_VALIDITY: no overlap skipped, containment kept whole, partial overlap SPLIT with the amount re-derived by ADJUST_COST_DIST_AMOUNT. DET_BIENNIUM_FROM_ENC_IV asserts the encumbrance interval must end 31 December and span at least one year, then sets biennium.BEGDA = interval.BEGDA and biennium.ENDDA(4) = BEGDA(4) + 1. claims.claim: THERE IS NO VACANCY TOLERANCE — THE AUTHORED RULE P2B-3 DESCRIBES AN INTENT THE SYSTEM DOES NOT IMPLEMENT (s097, read from production source). P2B-3 states that 'a vacant post does not hold a commitment beyond its declared vacancy tolerance'. Read in P01: ZCL_IM__UNESCO_ENCUMB_VACANCY~DO_REQUIREMENT_FILTRATION delegates straight to DO_HANDLE_VACANCY, which only calls SUPER — so the vacancy filter is BINARY, vacant or not, with no duration term anywhere. Its DO_HANDLE_COMMITMENT_PERIOD is literally `ASSERT 1 = 2.` with the comment 'No filtering over period ==> in this scenario this is done in ZCL_IM__UNESCO_ENCUMB_ENCPER' — a deliberate guard saying this path must never execute. And ENCPER's IF_HRFPM_DC_PERIOD~OBJECT_GET_PERIOD does not bound the vacancy either: it takes the encumbrance validity interval and CUTS IT WITH THE OBJECT'S OWN EXISTENCE INTERVAL. SO A VACANT POST HOLDS ITS COMMITMENT FOR THE WHOLE FUNDING WINDOW, however long it has been vacant. Three things bound the commitment and NONE of them is a tolerance: the encumbrance interval/biennium (PBC-R3), the object's existence interval (this method), and the extension horizon MV_EXTENSION_YEARS (PBC-R4). All three are windows of the FUNDING or of the OBJECT; none limits how long a vacancy may lock budget. This is the answer to the question the reconciliation left open, and it is the second of the two possibilities: not 'the tolerance lives elsewhere' but 'the authored rule states an intent that is not implemented'. Whether it SHOULD be is a decision for the budget office, not a defect to fix silently.

claims.claim: THE ATTRIBUTION FINDING IS ALSO A LICENSING FINDING, AND IT IS THE FIRST CONCRETE CONTENT FOR R_S4_READINESS (s097, user insight). The same measurement that shows 5.3M calls with no attributable actor also describes the tenant's DIGITAL ACCESS exposure, because SAP licenses indirect use by DOCUMENTS CREATED THROUGH NON-DIALOG CHANNELS — which is precisely what algorithm A8 already derives per object class. THE STRUCTURE OF THE RISK. Today, a satellite calling over RFC under a technical account costs a system-user licence and nothing per call. On S/4HANA — and far more sharply on S/4HANA CLOUD — that same traffic is API consumption and Digital Access documents. This tenant's operating model is 80% external, so the exposure is not a detail of the migration: it is the shape of the migration. Every integration that is free today becomes a metered cost. WHAT MAKES IT MEASURABLE RIGHT NOW, with no new extraction: A8 classifies each object class by write channel, and the classes written through RFC_INBOUND are exactly the candidates for Digital Access counting. FMRESERV alone carries 6,951,908 change documents; the named writers already include BAPI_PO_CREATE1, BAPI_PR_CREATE, BAPI_INCOMINGINVOICE_CREATE1, BAPI_GOODSMVT_CREATE and ZBAPI_VENDOR_CREATE2 — all document-creating calls from outside. AND THE OPAQUE ACCOUNTS ARE THE WORST CASE TWICE OVER. MULESOFT (3.23M calls, one identity), BRIDGE-RFC (2.11M, no caller field) and UBO-RFC (324K) cannot be attributed to a person — so they can be neither excused as named-user activity nor apportioned to a business owner. In a licensing negotiation, traffic you cannot attribute is traffic you cannot defend. WHY THIS MATTERS FOR THE MODEL: R_S4_READINESS was the ONE completely empty column across all 21 domains. It now has its first anchor, and the anchor is commercial rather than technical — which is probably why it stayed empty: we were looking for technical readiness factors.

claims.claim: S_STANDARD_REF IS FILLABLE — the 2016-2019 design corpus in unesco-sap-brain is the one thing there we cannot reproduce, and it unblocks the model's biggest structural gap (s097, cross-project exploration, paths verified to exist). WHAT THAT PROJECT STRUCTURALLY IS, and it must be read first: its own refs_external.json declares US its upstream — 'abapobjectscreation: SAP execution truth source' — so every DATA-derived claim there comes from our golden. What is genuinely theirs is the design corpus (33 sources / 46 original files) and the Salesforce side. SEVEN RANKED FILLERS, recorded as records in brain_v2/s_standard_ref_sources.json. The distinction that decides their value: only the UMOJA (UN Secretariat, 199pp) and OECD fit-gap material is genuinely SAP-STANDARD; the BBPs are UNESCO's AS-DESIGNED intent authored by SAP SE / SAP Suisse / Capgemini. Recording as-designed as 'standard' would make every UNESCO choice look like SAP behaviour and every SAP deviation look like a defect. BBP-04 fills PSM_FM with the BCS 7 dimensions and the AVC ADDRESS TRIPLE (Posting / Budget / Control) — which names something our own avc_availability_model.md has no word for. IT CORRECTS A DECISION I MADE EARLIER THE SAME SESSION. I set PBC.S_STANDARD_REF to NOT_APPLICABLE reasoning that the engine is overridden so the SAP standard does not apply. That conflated two things: SAP-standard indeed does not apply, but an AS-DESIGNED reference EXISTS — BBP10 section 6, the counterpart of what we read from production source in ZCL_IM__UNESCO_ENCUMB. Reset to NONE: obtainable and not obtained is a different statement from does not apply. THEY HOLD NO SAP TABLE RELATIONS. Zero table-to-table joins with keys; their measured ERM is SALESFORCE, not SAP. FMIFIIT.KNBELNR appears nowhere there. So the B2R chain budget->commitment->actual->AVC is OURS with real keys. THE HOLE IS THE REPORT LEG: FMIT is absent from the golden (verified — only fmavct_* and the fmavc* config tables exist) and the OFFICIAL negative-funds report YFM1 reads FMIT, not FMAVCT. FMRESERV is absent too, so the PBC->FM commitment join is evidenced by CHANGE DOCUMENTS rather than by the reservation records. FOUR CONTRADICTIONS, the sharpest being that their 26-step FMDERIVE strategy — the spine of their entire Bridge Approach — does not exist in production as described. FMDT_FIELD and FMDT_STEP do not exist on EhP8; derivation lives in TABADR*, strategy FMOA has 14 steps, and the FI leg is set by user exit ZXFMDTU02_RPY rather than by any table-driven strategy. Anything downstream of 'extend FMDERIVE Step 18' rests on a 2019 document, not on the machine. Also: their -$47.2M negative-funds figure is RETRACTED BY THEM (an artifact of parsing trailing-minus strings and summing without the value-type leg); the official figure is -$1.94M across 5 RP Output-Pool funds.

So a NOT_IMPLEMENTED verdict against a superseded blueprint says the design became irrelevant, not that the system failed. The peer project's own knowledge/36 had already named this failure mode: a 'design-doc artifact overtaken by the as-run'. Superseded in framing by the as-run claim below.
claims.claim: THE MODEL DID ITS STATED JOB FOR THE FIRST TIME: G = delta = the product, measured (s097, AN-INGEST-S-STANDARD-REF first pass, PSM_FM from BBP-04). THE HEADLINE, and it is the largest conformance finding this project has produced: BBP-04 defines FM AREA CONSOLIDATION — nine areas into one, `UNSC` — and calls it a HARD PREREQUISITE on which consolidated reporting, a unified commitment-item catalog and a single derivation strategy all depend. PRODUCTION RUNS NINE FM AREAS: IBE, ICBA, ICTP, IIEP, MGIE, UBO, UIL, UIS, UNES — measured in fmioi.BUKRS and fmavct_2026.RFIKRS, and it is the 2017 AS-IS list itself minus IESALC and IITE. Nine years on, the structure the design was written to replace is still the structure. This is not a pending item: a unified catalog and a single strategy are not partially achievable across nine areas, so a large part of BBP-04 is UNREACHABLE rather than unfinished. FIVE RULES INGESTED with the delta attached to each. S1 single FM area NOT_IMPLEMENTED. S2 the seven BCS dimensions PARTIAL, because dimension 3 (Grant) requires GM and GM has ZERO tables in the golden — and because our own bridge still carries PROJ.PSPID = GEBER as a static proxy, i.e. project-as-fund, the exact equivalence the design set out to reverse. S3 the AVC ADDRESS TRIPLE (Posting / Budget / Control) CONFORMS — the control record is keyed Fund x Fund Center x GROUPED commitment item, matching the design's own worked example. S4 FMDERIVE DEVIATES: the outcome holds but the mechanism is the user exit ZXFMDTU02_RPY rather than a table-driven strategy, so the user experience conforms and the maintainability does not. S5 PBET UNVERIFIED. THE MOST USEFUL RULE IS THE ONE THAT CONFORMS. S3 gives us the VOCABULARY our own avc_availability_model.md lacked: we had measured the control address correctly and had no name for the distinction between posting, budget and control addresses. It also explains WHY the hand-rolled `available = budget - commitment - actual` was refuted — that formula assumes posting address equals control address, and here it does not. A standard reference earns its keep by naming what you already measured. PSM_FM S_STANDARD_REF NONE -> PARTIAL and G_CONFORMANCE NONE -> PARTIAL. PARTIAL and not HAVE on purpose: one document of seven, one domain of six.

claims.claim: THE SEVEN-DIMENSIONAL BCS RUNS AS THREE DIMENSIONS (s097, measured against the SAP-standard coding block from the UN Secretariat's Umoja reference). Across 2,308,814 FM line items in fmifiit_full: Fund (FONDS) 100%, Funds Center (FISTL) 100%, Commitment Item (FIPEX) 100% — and then four empty. Funded Program (MEASURE) 0.0%. Functional Area (FAREA) 0.0%, its only distinct value being blank. Grant 0%, consistent with GM having zero tables. Budget Period column absent entirely. THIS IS NOT A SHORTFALL AT THE MARGIN: four of seven dimensions carry no value in a single row out of 2.3 million. FUNCTIONAL AREA IS THE ONE THAT SHOULD ALARM. BBP-04 defines it as UNESCO's C/5 EXPECTED RESULTS — the programme structure, used for STATUTORY REPORTING BY PROGRAMME OBJECTIVE. It is the dimension that ties money to purpose, and it is blank in every row, which means budget consumption cannot be reported by programme objective from FM at all. For an organisation whose mandate is literally expressed as C/5 Expected Results, that is the gap worth taking to the business. FUNDED PROGRAM BEING EMPTY EXPLAINS SOMETHING BOTH PROJECTS HAD ONLY OBSERVED. It is the designed WBS-to-FM bridge. Our model and theirs both carry PROJ.PSPID = GEBER — project-as-fund — and both label it a STATIC PROXY without explaining why it survives. It survives because the designed bridge dimension carries nothing: the fund code is the only project link that exists. Two open questions turn out to be one answered fact. METHOD NOTE: this is the first measurement in the project made against a genuinely SAP-STANDARD yardstick rather than against UNESCO's own design intent. BBP-04 says what UNESCO intended; the Umoja coding block says what SAP expects a public-sector posting to carry. claims.claim: THE BUDGET RATE MECHANISM WAS DESIGNED AWAY AND BUILT ANYWAY — and its failure mode is the reason it was designed away (s097, BBP-08 against production). BBP-08 calls it 'the most significant simplification': the practice of a special CONSTANT EXCHANGE RATE for EUR-to-USD conversion IN BUDGET EXECUTION is ELIMINATED. Constant dollar becomes strictly a REPORTING concept, an extra BW column. Budget control instead uses an additional AVC in BCS with a tolerance (~105%) RATHER THAN MANIPULATING POSTING EXCHANGE RATES — expressly so that postings use operational rates, for IPSAS. WHAT EXISTS IN PRODUCTION IS THE OPPOSITE: YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL manipulates the exchange rate during budget execution. And it carries a one-line defect confirmed in source — the conversion gate appends only 'EUR' to mr_waers, so a USD posting exits via CHECK without setting rv_is_ok and the conversion is SKIPPED SILENTLY. A trace recorded 42 invocations of the class and ZERO reads of TCURR: it fired and converted nothing. MEASURED BLAST RADIUS, already established in INC-BUDGETRATE-EQG and now attached to the rule: 458 funds carry EUR-loaded reservations with USD consumption; 135,792 bypass postings lifetime; $375,011,484.95 of volume; ~$35.7M of theoretical AVC drift exposure; 70 funds still exposed in 2026 with 214 bypass postings already made. WHY THIS IS THE CLEAREST DEMONSTRATION IN THE PROJECT OF WHY S_STANDARD_REF MATTERS: without the as-designed reference the incident reads as 'a bug to fix'. With it, the same facts read as 'a mechanism the blueprint explicitly eliminated was implemented, and the failure it produces is the very reason for the elimination'. The design's alternative — an AVC tolerance in BCS — cannot have this failure class at all, because it never touches the posting rate. Same evidence, different conclusion, and a different remedy: fix the gate, or retire the mechanism for what BBP-08 specified. AND AN IPSAS ANGLE THAT IS NOT OURS TO DECIDE: the design's stated reason for the deletion was that postings must use OPERATIONAL exchange rates. A mechanism that overrides the posting rate is therefore not merely fragile — it sits against the standard the design was aligning to. That is a question for the business.

claims.claim: THE BUDGET RATE SOLUTION READ FROM PRODUCTION — the perimeter, the three gates and a SECOND latent defect of the same shape as the known one (s097, package YA extracted from P01: 136 objects; 18 in the BR family — 5 classes, 1 composite ENHC, 12 ENHO). FIRST, AN EVIDENCE CORRECTION: the incident cited extracted_code/CLAS/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL/CM00A as the source of the one-line defect, and THAT PATH DOES NOT EXIST in any of the three corpora. The root cause was confirmed by a debugger session and a trace, which is strong evidence — but the most-quoted line was unreadable until now. The real source is extracted_sap_p01/YA/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL.abap, 634 lines. THE APPLICABILITY PERIMETER IS EIGHT DIMENSIONS, all of which must pass, each a CHECK that exits silently: ledger = 9A (note: NOT the AVC ledger 9H); company code = UNES; FM area = UNES; business area = GEF; currency = EUR ONLY (the defect); commitment item EXCLUDES GAINS and REVENUE; transaction EXCLUDES HRM1/HRM2/HRP1, so PBC pre-commitment, PBC commitment and payroll are OUT of the main path; and fund type IN a DATA-DRIVEN set from FMFUNDTYPE WHERE ZZFIX_RATE = X — measured in P01 as 14 types, all UNES (001-005, 009, 010, 012, 013, 016-018, 094, 095), i.e. Regular Programme only. Earmarked 101-115, MBF 299 and CRP 311/314 are NOT in the perimeter. THERE IS AN ACTIVATION SWITCH NOBODY HAD RECORDED: CHECK_BR_IS_ACTIVE compares sy-datum against MV_START_DATE, read from the TVARVC variable Y_FM_FIXED_RATE_START. Measured in P01: 20240101, so BR has been active since 1 January 2024. THE TRAP: if that variable is missing, the code defaults the date to '99991231' and BR silently never activates — a kill switch that fails closed and says nothing. THREE GATES, NOT ONE, and the difference between them is where the asymmetry lives. CHECK_CONDITIONS is the main path: EUR only, PBC and payroll excluded. CHECK_CONDITIONS_2 is the STAFF path: it accepts EUR *and* USD and INCLUDES HRM1/HRM2/HRP1 — so the cure for the currency defect exists inside the class and is unreachable from the main path. CHECK_CONDITIONS_3 is the complement, used for DELETION during RFFMREPO reconstruction: inverted membership on ledger/company/FM-area/business-area, and it INCLUDES what the others exclude. A SECOND LATENT DEFECT, NEW: the staff gate also checks IV_HKONT IN MR_HKONT, and MR_HKONT is DECLARED at line 57 and NEVER POPULATED anywhere in the class. In ABAP a value IN an empty range is FALSE, so whenever a GL account is passed the staff gate FAILS ALWAYS. Same shape as the known mr_waers defect — a range that gates and is never filled — and it means the one path that would have handled USD is itself closed on that condition.

The 14 flagged types all sit inside that range, but the range is far wider — so the constant-dollar report covers funds the engine never converted, and nothing reconciles the two. claims.claim: THE BUDGET-RATE SOLUTION HAS TWO FUND PERIMETERS AND THEY DISAGREE (s097, read from P01 production source). EXECUTION side, YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL: the fund-type range is built from FMFUNDTYPE WHERE ZZFIX_RATE = X — data-driven, measured as 14 types in UNES (001-005, 009, 010, 012, 013, 016-018, 094, 095). REPORTING side, YFM_CONSTANT_DOLLAR plus its variants _V2 and _DB_V2: S_TYPE is DEFAULTED at INITIALIZATION to a LITERAL range 001 to 099, commented 'Set fund type for GEF'. THE 14 FLAGGED TYPES ALL SIT INSIDE 001-099, BUT THE RANGE IS FAR WIDER. So a fund whose type falls in 001-099 without the ZZFIX_RATE flag appears in the constant-dollar report having NEVER been converted at execution. The report and the engine do not agree on who is in scope, and nothing reconciles them — which is the shape that produces 'the report says one thing and the system did another'. A NUANCE THAT CHANGES HOW TO FIX IT: S_TYPE is a SELECT-OPTIONS defaulted at INITIALIZATION, not a hard gate. An operator can widen or narrow it on the selection screen, so the reporting perimeter is whatever is left on the screen — and the mismatch with execution is silent in both directions. AND THE HARD-CODED LIST IS STILL THERE, COMMENTED: lines 92 and 97 of the class carry 'APPEND ... low = 019' behind a quote, the predecessor of the select. Two generations of perimeter logic sitting in one constructor.

evidence_for.cite: execution: SELECT FUND_TYPE FROM FMFUNDTYPE WHERE ZZFIX_RATE = abap_true -> 14 types; reporting: APPEND VALUE #( SIGN='I' OPTION='EQ' LOW='001' HIGH='099' ) TO S_TYPE, in three programs

claims.claim: THE BLUEPRINT'S AS-IS IS THE SYSTEM'S AS-RUN, NINE YEARS ON — three measurements converge (s097, BBP-06 ingested for Cost_Recovery_CRP). BBP-06 is described in the programme as its most comprehensive blueprint, because extra-budgetary donor funding is a major part of UNESCO's activity. BBP-06 states the AS-IS it set out to replace: donor agreements tracked OUTSIDE SAP in SPREADSHEETS and SISTER, 'with only indirect representation through MISUSED FUND AND WBS MASTER DATA OBJECTS'. claims.claim: THE B2R YARDSTICK IS THE AS-RUN, NOT THE BLUEPRINT — frame correction on my own ingest (s097, user-directed). WHAT I DID WRONG: I read the 2017 BBPs and measured production against them, producing 17 rules whose verdicts were mostly NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The MEASUREMENTS are real and stand — nine FM areas, zero gm* tables, 18 commitment items, Functional Area and Funded Program blank across 2,308,814 rows. THE FRAME WAS WRONG. Measuring against a superseded design turns 'the organisation built something else' into 'the system failed', and those are different claims with different remedies. WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENED, measured from both ends independently: UNESCO kept SAP as the SYSTEM OF RECORD and moved the SYSTEM OF ENGAGEMENT entirely outside it — Salesforce / Core Planner, ORION, named-user portals. Not around SAP; IN FRONT OF it. The peer project derived this from the Salesforce event log (23,730 status events, 26,075 posting events); we derived the same model from the SAP audit log (15.6M RFC calls). Two instruments, one model. THE REAL B2R END-TO-END, measured per workplan on real timestamps: plan to Validated median 20.9 DAYS (p90 428) — the human planning loop; Validated to first SAP posting median 1.8 DAYS — the integration seam; 5,929 workplans reached SAP and 91.7% carry a Financial_Summary return; 26,075 posting events of which 82.9% are budget transfers. SO THE BOTTLENECK IS HUMAN VALIDATION, NOT TECHNOLOGY AND NOT CONFIGURATION. The cross-system handoff is near-instant. Any B2R improvement effort aimed at SAP configuration is aimed at the fast part. THE FAILURE MODES ARE NAMED AND ATTRIBUTED: the forward sync is SERIAL and STOP-ON-FIRST-ERROR, so one failing object halts an entire workplan. 103 workplans and 354 allocations carry errors — fund create/assign ~130 (top single error: 'Assignment to 43 C/5 not possible with fund validity 01.01.2024-31.12.2025', 39 times), project create ~67. And INT-05, the Fund Center master channel SAP to Core Planner, has been BLOCKED SINCE 2023. THE WARNING WAS ALREADY WRITTEN IN THEIR OWN WORK. knowledge/36 re-scored one of its own claims with this exact diagnosis — the 'manual entry' reading of FC/CC/FA was 'a DESIGN-DOC ARTIFACT OVERTAKEN BY THE AS-RUN' — and deprecates any dialog-based baseline outright: 'a redesign baselined on dialog usage is baselined on <20% of the real traffic'. I walked into the failure mode their document names. WHAT THE BBP INGEST IS STILL WORTH: archaeology and vocabulary. The AVC address triple named a distinction we had measured and could not name, and that keeps its value. The rest is a record of what was intended, not a scorecard for what is.

evidence_for.cite: plan->Validated median 20.9d, Validated->first posting median 1.8d, n=721; 5,929 workplans in SAP, 91.7% with Financial_Summary; 26,075 posting events, 82.9% transfers; 103 workplans with sync errors; INT-05 blocked since 2023

claims.claim: THE MODEL DIMENSIONS LIVE IN THE IDENTIFIER STRING, NOT IN THE SCHEMA — measured end-to-end on the golden (s098, ALGORITHM A10). THE FM LEDGER POSTS ON EXACTLY TWO LEGS. In fmifiit_full, 2,308,814 actual lines: FONDS 100%, FISTL 100%, FIPEX 100% — and MEASURE (Funded Program), FAREA (Functional Area), GRANT_NBR and PRCTR are populated in 0.0%. MEASURE is the DESIGNED WBS-to-FM bridge, so the designed chain from work to money does not exist in the data. AND THERE IS NO FOREIGN KEY EITHER. prps carries no fund and no fund-centre column; proj carries none. Nothing in the PS master points at FM. YET THE CHAIN RESOLVES AT 99.5%, THROUGH THE STRING. Every WBS identifier is <fund code>.<level>.<level>: taking the root before the first dot, 59,424 of 59,749 WBS elements land on a real fund. The project id IS a fund code — 13,812 of 13,976 PSPID values (98.8%), the project-as-fund inversion the 2017 design explicitly forbade, still load-bearing. The 4-level spine is dot DEPTH, not a parent key. THE GRAMMAR IS ALSO A CLASSIFICATION. Three code families coexist in funds.FINCODE and each predicts the TYPE family: all-numeric 8 or 10 digits (73.2% of the UNES master) for RP/staff types 0xx; NNN+GEO+NNNN (20.8%) for extrabudgetary delivery types 1xx; alpha-prefixed legacy variants for older VC types. Fund centres are 3-letter organisational acronyms (84.0%). SO THE IMPLICIT TAXONOMY IS REAL AND IT IS THE OPERATING MODEL: the filters, groupings and hierarchies the business uses daily are encoded in identifier positions that no foreign key, no data dictionary and no migration tool can see. WHY THIS IS THE FINDING AND NOT A CURIOSITY: a link that works through a string convention is invisible to anyone reading the data model. It is never documented, never load-tested, and — the part that costs money — never migrated. An S/4 conversion that rebuilds the schema faithfully, not knowing the semantics live in the strings, carries none of this across.

evidence_for.cite: fmifiit_full MEASURE/FAREA/GRANT_NBR/PRCTR 0 of 2,308,814; root(POSID) resolves 59,424 of 59,749 (99.5%); PSPID matches a fund 13,812 of 13,976 (98.8%); funds.FINCODE 30 shapes over 56,752 UNES funds

claims.claim: AVAILABILITY CONTROL RUNS ON A SHARED POOL — quantified from the posted data (s098, A10). At 63.7% of Fund x Fund Centre addresses, SEVERAL distinct commitment items arrive at a SINGLE grouped bucket in the control object. Measured over the 5,949 addresses common to both sides: 3.99 distinct FIPEX on the posting side against 1.48 distinct RCMMTITEM on the control side. THE CONSEQUENCE IS NOT THAT CONTROL FAILS — IT IS THAT ATTRIBUTION DOES. Availability is checked on the pooled bucket, so consumption by one cost category silently reduces the headroom of its neighbours, and no report built on AVC can answer 'did this category have budget'. TWO INSTRUMENTS, ONE MODEL: the peer project reached this mechanism from CONFIGURATION (79.8% of controlled funds sit on a single TC pool); this reaches it from the POSTED DATA. Independent derivations of the same structure. PAIRED WITH THE FACT THAT ONLY A MINORITY OF FUNDS CARRY A CONTROL OBJECT AT ALL, the operating picture is a permissive preventive layer over a pooled address, with negatives caught afterwards by a detective report rather than prevented.

claims.claim: FUND RESERVATIONS ARE LONG-LIVED AND REPEATEDLY ADJUSTED, ON A BIENNIUM RHYTHM — NOT A MONTHLY ONE (s098, measured on 6,415,467 FMRESERV change headers). THE OPERATOR'S RECOLLECTION was that reservations are adjusted MONTH BY MONTH so the funds are never released. The data confirms the RETENTION and refutes the MONTHLY. WHAT IS MEASURED: 874,143 distinct reservation documents carry 6,415,467 changes, 7.3 per document on average — and FMRESERV is the largest change-document class in the system. Among documents that live SIX MONTHS OR MORE (416,680 of them), the median document is touched in 32% of the months it exists, with a median of 6 changes, and only 12% are touched in 80% or more of their months. So they are maintained repeatedly across a long life, not topped up every month. THE LIFETIME DISTRIBUTION IS THE REAL SIGNAL, and it is not smooth. It spikes hard at structural boundaries: 145,354 documents live exactly 13 months and 87,353 live exactly 25 months. Twenty-five months is a BIENNIUM. These reservations are created and carried to the end of a budget period rather than consumed and closed — which is the retention behaviour the recollection describes, running on the budget calendar instead of the monthly one. The 25-month cohort also carries the highest adjustment count, a median of 11 changes each. THE ARTIFACT THAT NEARLY PRODUCED A WRONG ANSWER, recorded because it is the more useful lesson: measured over ALL documents the ratio of months-with-a-change to months-of-life has a MEDIAN OF 0.96, which reads as 'touched in essentially every month of its life' and would have confirmed the monthly reading outright. It is an artifact. A document created and closed inside one month scores 1.00 by construction, and 34.7% of documents live exactly one month. Excluding short lives moves the median from 0.96 to 0.32. THE RATIO WAS MEASURING DOCUMENT LIFETIME, NOT ADJUSTMENT BEHAVIOUR. WHAT REMAINS OPEN: whether the AMOUNT moves down in step with consumption (a genuine commitment drawdown) or is restored (a hold). That needs the value history in CDPOS, which is deliberately deferred, or the amounts in fmioi joined per document.

evidence_for.cite: 874,143 documents / 6,415,467 changes / 7.3 avg; life>=6 months n=416,680 median ratio 0.32, median 6 changes, 12.0% at >=0.8; lifetime spikes at 13 months n=145,354 and 25 months n=87,353; all-documents median ratio 0.96 is an artifact of 34.7% single-month lives

claims.resolution_notes: First of the operator's B2R recollections put to data. The retention behaviour is real; the monthly cadence is not. Recorded with the artifact intact because the artifact is the transferable lesson: a ratio whose denominator is a lifetime measures the lifetime unless the short lives are excluded.

claims.claim: FUNDED PROGRAM IS EMPTY BECAUSE THE DERIVATION THAT WOULD FILL IT WAS NEVER CONFIGURED — the causal chain, closed with evidence from P01 (s098). THE QUESTION THIS ANSWERS: MEASURE (Funded Program) is populated in 0.0% of 2,308,814 FM actual lines. That could mean the designed chain was switched OFF, or that it was never BUILT. Those are different findings with different remedies, and until now we could not tell them apart. FOUR MEASUREMENTS, IN ORDER. (1) SAP's own rule: Funded Program is never assigned directly — in integrated postings its account assignment is ALWAYS DERIVED at posting time, via FMDERIVE, and it is BCS-only. (2) The derivation tool holds NO STRATEGY: T811C, T811S and T811K are EMPTY in P01, verified with and without a TAB='FMDERIVE' filter, returning zero rows rather than an error. (3) FMDERIVE IS NOT EVEN A REGISTERED DERIVATION POINT: T811X registers exactly four — CCSS, CEST7, GLPCT, JBDST7 — and FMDERIVE is not among them. (4) MEANWHILE THE MECHANISM ACTUALLY IN USE IS THE CLASSIC ONE AND IT IS FULLY POPULATED: TABADRSF carries 3,627 derivation rule rows, with TABADRST 253, TABADRS 170, TABADRX 43, TABADRH 32 and TABADRPCONF 20. THE CONCLUSION IS STRUCTURAL, NOT ACCIDENTAL. UNESCO derives FM account assignments through the CLASSIC account-assignment derivation, which fills Fund, Fund Center and Commitment Item — exactly the three that measure 100% — and which CANNOT derive Funded Program. The mechanism that can derive it, the derivation tool behind FMDERIVE, was never configured at all. So the empty column is not neglect and not a switch that someone turned off: the organisation runs a derivation architecture in which that dimension has no way to be filled. WHY IT MATTERS FOR WHAT COMES NEXT: every proposal to 'start using Funded Program' is really a proposal to stand up a second derivation mechanism and migrate onto it, which is a different size of change from configuring a field. And it explains why the identifier convention exists — the grammar is not a shortcut around a working feature, it is the only carrier available under the architecture actually in place.

evidence_for.cite: T811C/S/K return 0 rows with and without TAB='FMDERIVE'; T811X registers 4 points (CCSS, CEST7, GLPCT, JBDST7), FMDERIVE absent; TABADRSF 3,627 rows, TABADRST 253, TABADRS 170, TABADRX 43, TABADRH 32, TABADRPCONF 20; MEASURE 0 of 2,308,814

Class 0102 holds GL ACCOUNT groups keyed by chart of accounts — its SUBCLASS values are CAAU, CABE, GKR, IKR and its leaves are accounts like 0000510000, and it matches the fund-centre master at 0.0%. THE FUND CENTRES ARE CLASS 0312: 175 sets, 150 nodes, 878 leaves, matching the master at 100%. I assigned the class from the standard SAP convention instead of checking the leaf values against the master, which is the same mistake as reading a naming pattern for a fact. Everything else in the claim stands — the extraction volumes and the fact that the hierarchies are now held are unaffected. Superseded on this point by the claim below.

claims.CORRECTION_s098: MY ERROR on one point, corrected by measuring the whole population instead of the sample. The claim states that the orphan fund centres are NUMERIC codes while the hierarchy is built on three-letter acronyms, and concludes that the identifier grammar predicts hierarchy membership. claims.claim: THE ORGANISATION'S OWN CONTROL DEFINES THE BUDGET-RATE IMPACT, AND IT SUBTRACTS IT TO FIND THE REAL RECONCILIATION BREAK (s098, YFM_FI_COMPARE_INCLUDING_BR extracted from P01 at the user's pointer). THE CONTROL'S SHAPE. The report is a 64-line shell over YCL_FM_FI_COMPARE_BL. Its selection screen offers three views and the middle one is the point: C_DIFF_DATABASE (differences in the data), C_DIFF_BR (differences CAUSED BY THE BUDGET RATE) and C_NO_RESTRICTION. So the two kinds of difference are separated by design, not by analysis. THE FORMULA, at line 709 of the comparison class: FINAL_DIFF = FKBTR - DMBTR - ZZAMOUNTBRDIFF. FM minus FI, MINUS the part attributable to the budget rate. What remains is the genuine break. The budget-rate difference is EXPECTED and netted out, which is what makes the control usable: a controller looking at FINAL_DIFF is looking at what the rate does not explain. AND THE BASELINE IS NOT ONE THING. GET_BR_IMPACT computes ZZAMOUNTBRLC — the amount at the standard rate — by FOUR different routes depending on the value type. (1) WRTTP '54', actuals: take BSEG-DMBTR directly, sign-corrected by SHKZG ('H' multiplies by -1), either passed in or re-read from BSEG on the document key. (2) WRTTP '51' with VRGNG 'RMBE' and BTART '0200', a purchase-order REDUCTION: fetch the GOODS RECEIPT amount from EKBE through YCL_MM_PO_UTILITIES=>GET_EKBE_AMOUNTS_1 with VGABE '1', then multiply by -1 because it is a reduction. (3) otherwise, if the document carries its own rate KURSF: apply it, honouring SAP's indirect-quotation convention — a NEGATIVE KURSF means divide rather than multiply. (4) otherwise: CONVERT_TO_LOCAL_CURRENCY to USD with TYPE_OF_RATE 'M', and the comment on that branch names it: 'Convert Transaction Amount to UNORE' — the UN Operational Rate of Exchange. SO THE STANDARD SIDE OF THE COMPARISON IS THE UN OPERATIONAL RATE, and that is why the FI rates measured across 2025-2026 move between 1.02041 and 1.17233 while FM holds 1.09529. THE FLAG HAS TWO STATES AND BOTH ARE AGGREGATED SEPARATELY. ZZBRIMPACTED is 'E' when the transaction amount is ZERO — no rate can be derived — and 'X' otherwise. The report calls EXTRACT_GLOBAL_AMOUNT once for each, so a line that cannot be evaluated is reported apart rather than silently counted as zero impact. WHAT THIS DOES TO MY OWN MEASUREMENT. The -1,223,730.83 USD figure compared FKBTR against DMBTR, which is exactly route (1) — correct for WRTTP '54' actuals and NOT correct for purchase-order reductions or for lines carrying their own KURSF. The figure therefore holds for the actuals population and needs the other three routes to cover the rest. The organisation already implements all four.

claims.claim: THE BUDGET RATE FIRES AT TWELVE DISTINCT MOMENTS, AND EACH ONE APPLIES A DIFFERENT PERIMETER (s098, the twelve ZFIX enhancement sources extracted from P01 at last). HOW THEY WERE FINALLY READ. An ENHO has no program of its own; its source lives in a GENERATED INCLUDE named <ENHNAME> padded to 30 characters with '=' and closed with 'E'. ENHOBJ gives the hooked object and ENHINCINX gives the include name. With the right name, RPY_PROGRAM_READ reads it like any other program. All twelve came out — 1,154 lines. EXT-ENHO-SOURCE had stood open because the extractor skipped ENHO as unreadable; it was readable all along, under a name nobody had constructed. THE TWELVE MOMENTS, in lifecycle order: a COMMITMENT LINE is created (SAPLFMOI) · AVAILABILITY IS CHECKED (SAPLFMFC, FM_FUNDS_CHECK_FI and _OI) · a FUND IS RESERVED (FMR3, FMR3_FILL_KBFM_FROM_KBLX) · a FUND IS BLOCKED (SAPLFMFR) · EARMARKED FUNDS ARE REDUCED (CL_FM_EF_POSITION) · earmarked funds are CONSISTENCY-CHECKED (CL_FM_EF_POSITION) · the PAYMENT COMMITMENT is written (SAPLFMR_AD2) · an FI POSTING REACHES FM (SAPLFMRI) · a PBC POSITION is updated (CL_HRFPM_CD_PBC_UPDATE) · an EMPLOYEE EXPENSE is posted (BAPI_ACC_EMPLOYEE_EXP_POST) · COMMITMENTS ARE REVALUED (LFMOIF0M, LFMOIF1C) · RESERVED FUNDS ARE REVALUED (RFFMBW00). THE AVAILABILITY CHECK IS THE ONE THAT CHANGES THE MEANING. The rate is applied INSIDE FM_FUNDS_CHECK, before availability is decided — so the fixed rate is what the budget check sees. This is not a reporting adjustment applied afterwards; it changes what is allowed to post. AND NO TWO CALL SITES PASS THE SAME CONDITIONS. Seven of the eight are passed at the AVC, FI and new-item moments; six at fund reservation, fund block and earmarked-funds reduction (FIKRS derived from the company code in the last of these); and at REVALUATION — both of them — ONLY THE FUND TYPE IS PASSED. Since an unpassed parameter skips its check, revaluation carries NO currency restriction, NO business area, NO commitment item and NO business transaction. The EUR-only limit that shapes every other moment does not apply there. That is the widest gate in the solution and it is invisible from the class alone. THE STAFF PATH IS A SEPARATE MECHANISM. PBC position update and employee expense posting do not use the main perimeter: they gate through YCL_FM_BR_PBC_POSTING_BL and YCL_FM_BR_PAYROLL_POSTING_BL on the PERSONNEL NUMBER, and convert through a second method, CONVERT_TO_CURRENCY_2. ONE SMALL THING WORTH KEEPING: in the staff branch of the payment-commitment enhancement, IV_FIPEX is COMMENTED OUT — so the commitment-item exclusion of GAINS and REVENUE is deliberately not applied at that point.

evidence_for.cite: ENHOBJ hooked objects + ENHINCINX include names; call sites read per enhancement: 7 conditions at AVC/FI/NEW_ITEM, 6 at FUND_RESERVATION/FUNDBLOCK/KBLEW, only IV_FTYPE at BR_REVALUATION and BR_REVAL_RESFUND, PERNR at PBC_POS_UPD

claims.claim: THE FIXED RATE IS AN OPERATIONAL RATE, FROZEN — AND THAT EXPLAINS 2024 AND CORRECTS MY OWN READING OF IT (s098, AN-BR-2024-FI-AT-EURX). WHAT EURX ACTUALLY IS. 1.09529 is not an arbitrary constant. The UN operational rate for EUR/USD stood at exactly -0.91300 — implicit 1.09529 — from 2024-01-15. EURX was set to the operational rate in force at the START OF THE BIENNIUM and then held. The fixed rate is a SNAPSHOT of the moving one, which is why the two coincide at the beginning and diverge after. AND THE OPERATIONAL RATE CROSSED IT AGAIN. Through 2024 the rate moved 1.09529 (15 Jan), 1.08460, 1.07181, 1.08342, 1.09409, 1.08225, ... and came back to exactly 1.09529 on 15 AUGUST 2024, then went above it — 1.10865, 1.11857 — before falling away through 2025 to 1.04167 and 1.02041. SO THE 2024 'BUDGET RATE' LINES ARE MOSTLY COINCIDENCE, NOT CONVERSION. My filter selected FM lines whose FKBTR/TRBTR equals the EURX rate. In 2024 that catches lines where the OPERATIONAL rate simply WAS 1.09529 that day, so FI posted at it and FM inherited it unchanged. The evidence is decisive: across all 465 route-1 pairs in 2024 the impact is EXACTLY 0.00 — FM equals FI to the cent. A real conversion cannot produce an exact zero against a moving baseline; identical amounts mean no conversion took place. And the posting dates cluster where the rates met: 130 in January and 116 in August. THIS CORRECTS CLAIM 439, which read the 7.6% of 2024 perimeter lines at the EURX rate as the mechanism running partially in its first year. On route 1 it did not run: those lines are rate coincidence. The mechanism reaching 94.7% in 2025 and 97.1% in 2026 stands, because there the operational rate is nowhere near 1.09529 and the match can only come from conversion. THE METHOD LESSON, and it is the same shape as the EURX discovery itself: MATCHING A RATE IS NOT PROOF OF A MECHANISM when the baseline can take that value on its own. The test only separates the two when the fixed and moving rates differ — which is exactly when the impact is non-zero. An impact of exactly zero is not a small effect; it is the signature of no effect at all. ONE RESIDUAL, stated rather than smoothed: 70 of the zero-impact pairs post in February and 85 in September, when the operational rate was 1.08460 and 1.10865. Those need the TRANSLATION DATE (WWERT), which the golden's bkpf extract does not carry, before the coincidence explanation covers them too.

evidence_for.cite: M EUR->USD = -0.91300 (implicit 1.09529) from 2024-01-15 and again from 2024-08-15; EURX = 1.09529 from 2024-01-01; 2024 route-1 impact exactly 0.00 over 465 pairs; posting dates 130 in January, 116 in August
